title: A fixed small-entropy tree family with explicit N^(1/50) error

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total deterministic P family family.evaluate in proof.md. At actual N>=2 use n=N, Kmin=ceil(N^(1/100)), k=Kmin^2, and the supplied extractor/challenge-response tree on intervals[floor(i*N/t^j),floor((i+1)*N/t^j)). Unequal child lengths partition actual inputs exactly. All source/extractor parameters, fields, integer roots, numerical fallback0 and tree choices are specified by code and supplied proofs. No outer input padding, ignored target bits, program prefix, field input, advice or witness is used.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this ONE fixed total uniform P language, hence NP with empty witnesses, there exists N0 such that for EVERY integer N>=N0, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-8*ceil(N^(1/100))^2+4, hence C_B2(F_N)>=4N-8*N^(1/50)-16*N^(1/100)-4. In particular C_B2(F_N)>=4N-9*N^(1/50) eventually. Thus liminf over ALL integer N of C_B2(F_N)/N>=4. Supplied arguments prove deterministic prime-degree fields, a trace-cubic extractor, linear strong seeded extraction at a fixed polynomial entropy exponent1/100, affine row and block-source extraction, the recursive tree disperser at threshold ceil(N^(1/100))^2, and unrestricted full-B2 transfer at actual length N. All input bits are charged. No explicit N0, practical asymptotically large evaluation time or literature record is claimed; no prior verdict or external retrieval is a proof premise.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
